description:
Functional specifications / files: environment only; follow docs/agent-setup.md and worktree-setup guidance. Verify branch/base, effective isolated dev/test/E2E DB names, fetch locked dependencies, compile, create/migrate only verified isolated DBs and prepare local assets. No application changes, copying parent DBs, overwriting secrets or user-level installs without applicable authorization.
Readiness evidence 2026-11-27: Elixir 1.20.4/OTP28 present; effective dev database zaq_feat_delivery_execution and test database zaq_test_feat_delivery_execution verified via Config.Reader. Local PostgreSQL query succeeded but expected dev/test/E2E DBs absent. deps contains only heroicons, llm_db, nimble_pool and web_widget; _build, assets/node_modules, priv/static/assets and test/e2e/node_modules absent. config/dev.secret.exs exists; no secret contents logged. Missing .claude/settings.local.json is not a runtime dependency and must not prompt fabrication of host configuration.
Tests / branches: dependency resolution/compile, migration status, basic isolated DB connection and asset readiness; record failures and versions. No production tests changed.
Mocking plan: none; inspect real local tools and configuration with credentials redacted.
Documentation: record readiness evidence here; environment setup guide remains policy owner.
Action reuse assessment: not applicable, environment setup only. Acceptance: execution prerequisites verified against this worktree; no credentials leaked or sibling state modified.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.
